title: Running successful backup size
description: Consider only successful backups. For each database_name calculate running_size_mb as cumulative SUM(size_mb) ordered by finished_seq ASC, backup_id ASC. Return exactly five columns: backup_id, database_name, finished_seq, size_mb, running_size_mb. Final sort: database_name ASC, finished_seq ASC, backup_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT backup_id, database_name, finished_seq, size_mb,
       SUM(size_mb) OVER (
       ) AS running_size_mb
FROM backups
hints: PARTITION BY database_name restarts accumulation for each database.
Two ordering fields make accumulation deterministic when finished_seq ties.
solution_explanation: A window SUM preserves every backup row while exposing cumulative size.
